items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember my drummer at the time was Andrew Cyrille.

ctx.x: Oh my god, but I heard it once on An Old Gray Whistle Test. I heard the band, the band sounded beautiful. But we were all trying to sing into microphones, background vocals and you couldn’t hear us. I don’t even think I could sing. But great composer, Jack Bruce. Great bass player, great composer. So after I got home from that I had a taste for fine wine, cigars, limousines... I just wanted to go back out on the road. Find the greatest hotel in town, people lighting matches in the audience...
